status: Human-readable structured mathematical benchmark; this JSON is not itself a formal semantics parser or proof.
exact_numbers: Fraction strings are exact rational numbers; illustrative decimal quantities are explicitly separated.

rate.variation: One unknown fixed value for the entire execution.

controller.sample_state: the trajectory itself evaluated at t[n]

errors.d: post-clamp scalar drive error, INSIDE rate multiplier
errors.time_variation: constant on each hold; arbitrary prescribed sequences across holds

execution.continuity: all three coordinates continuous on [0,infinity), including sample boundaries
execution.derivatives: pointwise classical derivatives on every OPEN hold interval; none imposed at switches

acceptance_properties.name: existence
acceptance_properties.statement: There exists an execution for each admitted parameter and sequence choice.

acceptance_properties.name: uniqueness
acceptance_properties.statement: Any two executions for the same fixed parameters, sequences and initial state agree for all t>=0.

acceptance_properties.name: energy_invariance
acceptance_properties.statement: For every execution and t>=0, f(t)^T*P*f(t)<=12.

acceptance_properties.name: position_envelope
acceptance_properties.statement: For every execution and t>=0, abs(x(t))<=2.

nonclaims: No external additive jerk outside rate
No globally shortest or optimal envelope claim
